decisions.title: Resolve Northstar's pilot success and uptime feedback before approving expansion
decisions.problem: Northstar's 1,200-user pilot mostly met its engagement, repeat-usage, and deployment goals, but customer uptime feedback remains unvalidated and blocks its company-wide rollout decision.
decisions.customerContext: Jordan Lee wants to determine whether the existing 1,200-user pilot succeeded; Casey Patel needs to understand the reported uptime concern and its actual operational impact before Northstar's $420,000 expansion can be considered.
decisions.proposedSolution: Have Sam Rivera ask Riley Morgan and solutions architect Priya Shah to review the existing pilot scorecard with Jordan Lee and Casey Patel, validate the uptime feedback, and agree on a documented rollout-readiness decision.
decisions.nextStep: Riley Morgan should propose a pilot-readiness review with Jordan Lee, Casey Patel, and Priya Shah before the customer decision; do not claim the meeting is booked.
